03-incomplete-node-name-fallback.atd.note: "met" is not registered — Unknown Command Fallback (Inline Spec §6), not an error.

04-bare-at-symbol-fallback.atd.note: Bare "@" and "@GitHub" both fall back to plain text (Inline Spec §2/§6).

05-stray-closing-bracket-fallback.atd.note: An unpaired "]" at the document root is lenient, not Strict-Mode-checked — see parseImplicitParagraph.

16-unclosed-raw-domain-silent-swallow.at.note: KNOWN LIMITATION: no EOF check in the raw-content scanner — it silently consumes to end of file instead of erroring. See tests/README.md.

18-svg-node-valid.atd.note: @svg is a raw pass-through node (like @mermaid) — embedded <svg> markup parses as opaque raw content, not escaped text.

19-color-node-valid.atd.note: @color(#ff0000)[...] — new inline node for literal text color, distinct from @mark's background highlight.

20-list-no-dash-valid.atd.note: @list items no longer require a leading "- " — any non-empty line is an item (Structural-Blocks.md §5 List).

21-list-ordered-valid.atd.note: @list(ordered)[...] — renders as <ol> instead of the default bullet <ul>.

22-list-ordered-manual-marker-valid.atd.note: A leading "N. "/"N)" on an item inside @list(ordered) is captured as an explicit marker (<li value="N">), letting the numbering jump/resume.

23-list-nested-valid.atd.note: A line holding only a nested @list[...] is folded into the previous item instead of becoming a sibling item, producing a real nested <ul>/<ol>.
